sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Basalt Deltas and Nether Wastes.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Ice moves are halved (0.5×).
Clear Smog, Rock Slide, Smack Down, Smog, and Thousand Arrows also count as Fire for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Clear Smog and Smog: 2× stronger.
Infernal Parade, Rock Slide, Smack Down, and Thousand Arrows: 1.5× stronger.
Will-O-Wisp: 100% accuracy.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Fire-type.
Nature Power becomes Flamethrower.
Secret Power can cause burn.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Continental Crush, Defog, Gust, Hurricane, Hydro Vortex, Muddy Water, Oceanic Operetta, Razor Wind, Sand Tomb, Sludge Wave, Sparkling Aria, Supersonic Skystrike, Surf, Tailwind, Twister, Water Pledge, Water Sport, Water Spout, and Whirlwind change the field into Cave.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Blaze: 1.5× power for Fire-type moves.
Fire Mane: 2× power for Fire-type moves.
Magma Armor: Defense +1 when it enters.
Pokémon cannot be frozen.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Steam Engine: Speed +1.

Each turn, grounded Pokémon that are not Fire-type (not those using Aqua Ring, Dig, or Dive) without Flame Body, Flare Boost, Flash Fire, Heatproof, Magic Guard, Magma Armor, Water Bubble, Water Veil, or Well-Baked Body lose 1/8 of their maximum HP (burned by the field).

sections.heading: Weather and status
lines: Hail cannot be started here.
Rain changes the field into Cave at the end of the turn.
Sandstorm changes the field into Cave at the end of the turn.
Snow cannot be started here.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Attack +1, Special Attack +1, Speed +1, and is bound by Fire Spin.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
